The outlaws of the {wiki:Outlaw Camp} are going through hard times and their leader, {npc:Rottin Wood}, needs help: getting rabbit's foot "lucky charms", repairing the camp walls and ambushing merchants crossing the forest. You earn gold, experience, the achievements Merry Adventures and Bunny Slipped and, in the daily tasks, a chance to receive a {item:Time Ring} or a {item:Hunting Horn}.

Rottin Wood's daily tasks (Lucky Loop and Handyman)
After the missions: ask {npc:Rottin Wood} for them with {key:task} ({key:lucky charms} or {key:repairs}).
They give experience and gold; Lucky Loop also gives a chance of a {item:Time Ring} (9%) or a {item:Hunting Horn} (about 1%).
Bring your own knife ({item:Obsidian Knife} or {item:Kitchen Knife}) and a {item:Hammer} before heading to the camp.
Do not lose the {item:Handcrafted Ribbon|Handcrafted Ribbons} or the nets: if you lose them you have to wait about 30 minutes for Rottin Wood to give you new ones.

The {wiki:Outlaw Camp} is on the surface, **west of Venore** and **east of Thais** (and of Blood Bay), west of the Plains of Havoc. Leave **Venore** and head **west** through the forest (or come from Thais to the **east**) to the camp. Enter along the stone path to the main houses: {npc:Rottin Wood} is in the **northernmost** building of the village.
Map of the Outlaw Camp with Rottin Wood's house
In and around the camp there are {creature:Wild Warrior|Wild Warriors}, {creature:Bandit|Bandits}, {creature:Smuggler|Smugglers} and {creature:Boar|Boars}.
Say {key:hi}, {key:quest}, {key:no} and {key:yes}. Rottin Wood gives you **7 {item:Handcrafted Ribbon|Handcrafted Ribbons}** and asks you for rabbit's feet.

Kill {creature:Rabbit|Rabbits} around the camp and use the {item:Kitchen Knife} or the {item:Obsidian Knife} on the corpses (wait **10 seconds** before skinning them). From each rabbit you can get 1 or 2 {item:Rabbit's Foot|Rabbit's Feet}, or fail. You can only skin successfully up to 7 rabbits per day (between 7 and 14 feet); after that a message appears saying you have skinned enough for today. You need at least **7 feet**.
Skinning a rabbit to get the foot
Use the {item:Handcrafted Ribbon|Handcrafted Ribbons} on the feet to make **7 {item:Rabbit's Foot Lucky Charm|Rabbit's Foot Lucky Charms}**.
If you lose the Handcrafted Ribbons you have to wait about 30 minutes to get more from Rottin Wood.
Go back to {npc:Rottin Wood} and say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}.
2. Mission 2: In a State of Disrepair
Ask {npc:Rottin Wood} for another mission: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes} and {key:yes} again.

Use the {item:Hammer} on the broken walls. There are 4 walls to repair in the houses around Rottin Wood and one more on the **top floor** of his house. You need to make **6 repairs** in total. After being repaired, a wall breaks again after **2 minutes**, so you can repair it again (up to 6 times on the same wall).
Repairing a broken wall with the hammer
Go back to {npc:Rottin Wood} and say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}.
Ask {npc:Rottin Wood} for the next mission: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes} and {key:yes}. He gives you **5 {item:Net|Nets}** and marks on your map the place where you should set them.
Go **north**, to the marked area, and use the 5 {item:Net|Nets} on the ground. When you have set them all, you are kicked out of the area and a {item:Small Fir Tree} blocks the entrance.
Area where you set the nets
Wait for 5 {creature:Travelling Merchant|Travelling Merchants} to fall into the nets. After **5 minutes** the tree disappears and you can go back in.
Rottin Wood suggests you keep watch from the big hunting stand (high seat) near the camp.
Go back into the area and 'Use' the 5 {item:Captured Merchant|Captured Merchants} to loot them.
If you do not collect the valuables from the 5 merchants, you have to wait 30 minutes to get more nets from Rottin Wood.
Go back to {npc:Rottin Wood} and say {key:hi} and {key:mission}.
1000 experience, 500 gp and the Merry Adventures achievement
After the missions you can repeat two tasks per day with {npc:Rottin Wood}, asking for them with {key:task}.

Say {key:hi}, {key:task}, {key:lucky charms} and {key:yes}. The task is the same as Mission 1: collect 7 {item:Rabbit's Foot|Rabbit's Feet} and use the Handcrafted Ribbons to make the Rabbit's Foot Lucky Charms.

Instead of real feet you can hand in **7 {item:Fake Rabbit's Foot|Fake Rabbit's Feet}** to earn the **Bunny Slipped** achievement. To make them, use the Handcrafted Ribbons on {item:Wooden Spoon|Wooden Spoons} to get {item:Spoon with a Ribbon|Spoons with a Ribbon} and then use them on {item:Wool}.
If you hand in the fake feet you receive 300 gp instead of the normal prize.
Go back to {npc:Rottin Wood} and say {key:hi}, {key:task}, {key:lucky charms} and {key:yes}.
100 experience and one of: 500 gp (90%), 300 gp + {item:Time Ring} (9%) or {item:Hunting Horn} (about 1%)
Say {key:hi}, {key:task}, {key:repairs} and {key:yes}. The task is the same as Mission 2: repair 6 broken walls with the {item:Hammer} (see coordinates in section 2).
After repairing the 6 walls, go back and say {key:hi}, {key:task}, {key:repairs} and {key:yes}.

The camp is far from any depot: walk back the same way, **east** to **Venore** or **west** to **Thais**. Watch out for the {creature:Wild Warrior|Wild Warriors}, {creature:Bandit|Bandits} and {creature:Smuggler|Smugglers} along the way.
Nowadays the only way to earn the Bunny Slipped achievement is to hand in 7 Fake Rabbit's Feet to Rottin Wood.
